**STEP 1 - Scene:** A cafeteria-style tray meal with a meat-and-pastry plate, a shawarma-style plate with shredded lettuce and cabbage, a side salad bowl, a small dressing cup, a drink, and a bottle of dark sauce. Plates are at the centre; the bottle and juice glass are off-plate.

**STEP 2 - Vessel:** Dinner-style paper plates, about 23 cm diameter (area ≈ 415 cm²). Side salad bowl about 15 cm (area ≈ 177 cm²). The dressing cup and drinks are not part of the plated food.

- Sliced roast meat (left plate)
- Pastry slice with a spinach or cheese filling (left plate)
- Shredded lettuce and cabbage mix (right plate)
- Sliced shawarma-style meat (right plate)
- Shredded white garnish, possibly cheese or onion (right plate)
- Mixed greens, cucumber and tomato (side bowl)
- Small cup of vinaigrette (dressing)

- Roast meat ≈ 12% (50 cm²)
- Pastry ≈ 18% (75 cm²)
